consumer: The salvage/mission contract completion check asking 'are all the contract's required scrap items present yet?' — the engine-computed eligibility predicate the UI relays, not a viewer of raw ground items.
scope: The contract's own required-collection scope (the required item set evaluated over the inventory/area the contract counts), not just ground stacks on nearby tiles inside the export window.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities(items) — iterates points_in_radius filtered by in_export_window and writes each map::i_at(p) ground-item stack; it never invokes any contract/mission completion predicate and only sees ground tiles in the window.
divergence: Required scrap is held in the player's backpack or an adjacent container, or sits one tile outside the export window: the contract is satisfiable/complete but items[] shows it absent (or miscounts charges-based scrap), yielding the wrong yes/no answer.
